mapper.sql: select task_id, business_table, business_id, business_details, sub_time, sub_per, audit_id, now_check_step, check_time, check_status, video_ids,create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, user_id, org_id from sys_audit_task

select sat.task_id, sat.business_table, sat.business_id, sat.business_details,sat.sub_time, sat.sub_per, sat.audit_id, sat.now_check_step, sat.check_time, sat.check_status, sat.create_by, sat.create_time, sat.update_by, sat.update_time, sat.del_flag, sat.user_id, sat.org_id , sat.video_ids ,samc.audit_type from sys_audit_task sat left join sys_audit_main_config samc on sat.audit_id = samc.audit_id
mapper.select:
select sat.task_id, sat.business_table, sat.business_id, sat.business_details,sat.sub_time, su.nick_name as sub_per, sat.audit_id, sat.now_check_step, sat.check_time, sat.check_status,sat.video_ids, sat.create_by, sat.create_time, sat.update_by, sat.update_time, sat.del_flag, sat.user_id, sat.org_id, samc.audit_title,samc.audit_type,sac.level_name from sys_audit_task sat LEFT JOIN sys_user su on su.user_id = sat.sub_per LEFT JOIN sys_audit_main_config samc on samc.audit_id = sat.audit_id LEFT JOIN sys_audit_config sac on sat.now_check_step = sac.config_id WHERE sat.del_flag = '0' and sat.check_status = '3'
and samc.audit_type = #{auditType}
and samc.audit_title like concat ('%',#{auditTitle},'%')
AND (su.nick_name like concat('%',#{subPer},'%') OR su.user_name like concat('%',#{subPer},'%') OR ((SELECT real_name from auth_info where user_id = sat.sub_per order by auth_time desc limit 1) like concat('%',#{subPer},'%')))
and (sat.audit_id, sat.now_check_step) IN
(#{cond.auditId}, #{cond.configId})
order by sat.task_id desc

select sub_id, task_id, audit_config_id, check_per, check_time, check_opinion, check_status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, user_id, org_id, admin_intervention from sys_audit_task_subinfo where task_id = #{taskId} and del_flag = '0' order by check_time asc
mapper.insert:

business_table, business_id, business_details, sub_time, sub_per, audit_id, now_check_step, check_time, check_status, video_ids, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, user_id, org_id,
#{businessTable}, #{businessId}, #{businessDetails}, #{subTime}, #{subPer}, #{auditId}, #{nowCheckStep}, #{checkTime}, #{checkStatus}, #{videoIds}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, #{delFlag}, #{userId}, #{orgId},
mapper.delete:
delete from sys_audit_task where task_id in
#{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(sats.check_opinion,'-') as checkOpinion FROM `sys_audit_task_subinfo` sats INNER JOIN sys_audit_task sat ON sats.task_id = sat.task_id WHERE sats.del_flag = '0' AND sat.business_table = #{tableName} AND sat.business_id = #{businessId} ORDER BY sats.create_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN sac.check_person_type = 'user' THEN (SELECT u.nick_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id = sac.check_person) WHEN sac.check_person_type = 'dept' THEN (SELECT d.org_name FROM sys_org d WHERE d.org_id = SUBSTRING_INDEX(sac.check_person_org,',',-1)) WHEN sac.check_person_type = 'role' or sac.check_person_type = 'deptRole' THEN (SELECT r.role_name FROM sys_role r WHERE r.role_key = sac.check_person_role) ELSE sac.check_person END AS nextName FROM sys_audit_config sac WHERE sac.audit_id = #{auditId} AND sac.is_enable = '1'
AND sac.config_id NOT IN
#{configId}
ORDER BY sac.level_sort ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT sac.config_id as configId,sac.level_sort as levelSort,sac.audit_id as auditId,sac.check_person_type as checkPersonType ,sac.check_person_org as checkPersonOrg , sac.check_person_role as checkPersonRole,sac.check_person , CASE WHEN sac.check_person_type = 'user' THEN u.nick_name WHEN sac.check_person_type = 'dept' THEN org.org_name WHEN sac.check_person_type = 'role' THEN r.role_name WHEN sac.check_person_type = 'deptRole' THEN CONCAT( org.org_name,'-',r.role_name) ELSE sac.check_person END AS nodeName, 'gray' as color FROM sys_audit_config sac LEFT JOIN sys_org org on org.org_id= sac.check_person_org LEFT JOIN sys_role r on r.role_key = sac.check_person_role LEFT JOIN sys_user u on u.user_id = sac.check_person WHERE sac.audit_id = #{auditId} AND sac.is_enable = '1' ORDER BY sac.level_sort ASC
